page.overview:
What is Rivil?

The Rivil was a stream in East Beleriand during the First Age.

Rivil was a tributary of the Sirion, flowing northwards from its source known as Rivil's Well in the highlands of Dorthonion until it met Sirion in the Fen of Serech. Its estimated length was about fifty miles, according to The Atlas of Middle-earth.
